title: STAR-Pro: Stage-Wise Token Adaptive Reduction with Progressive Refinement for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal understanding, but the hundreds to thousands of visual tokens they process impose substantial computational overhead, motivating training-free visual token pruning. In this work, we conduct two complementary analyses of visual token pruning. First, we measure the feature-space coverage of tokens retained before cross-modal fusion and find that aggressive pruning discards substantial visual information. Second, we track text-to-visual attention across decoder layers and find that the visual tokens considered important change substantially with depth, making one-shot pruning decisions unreliable. Together, these findings show that effective pruning should preserve broad visual coverage before fusion and progressively refine the retained tokens as cross-modal evidence evolves during fusion. translated_title: STAR-Pro：面向高效大型视觉语言模型的分阶段自适应令牌缩减与渐进式精炼方法
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）实现了强大的多模态理解能力，但其需要处理的数百至数千个视觉令牌带来了巨大的计算开销，这推动了无需训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法的发展。在本工作中，我们对视觉令牌剪枝进行了两项互补性分析。首先，我们测量了在跨模态融合之前保留令牌的特征空间覆盖率，发现激进的剪枝会丢弃大量视觉信息。其次，我们跟踪了解码器各层中文本到视觉的注意力分布，发现被视为重要的视觉令牌随网络深度变化显著，这使得一次性剪枝决策不可靠。这些发现共同表明，有效的剪枝方法应当在融合之前保留广泛的视觉信息覆盖，并在融合过程中随着跨模态证据的演化对保留的令牌进行渐进式精炼。因此，我们提出了STAR-Pro（分阶段自适应令牌缩减与渐进式精炼）……
tldr: 提出STAR-Pro方法，通过在跨模态融合前保留广泛的视觉信息覆盖、并在融合过程中分阶段渐进精炼视觉令牌，实现无需训练且更可靠的高效视觉令牌剪枝。
en_tdlr: STAR-Pro enables training-free and reliable visual token pruning for LVLMs by preserving broad visual coverage before cross-modal fusion and progressively refining retained tokens stage-wise as attention evolves across decoder layers.
